description: `loop.tombstones` lists the loops deleted from a component with the totals each earned before it went, newest first, `detached`: the tasks, roadmap items and queue items whose link to a loop a deletion cut, with the slug of the loop each lost and the cost a task had spent. A cost nobody reported is `unknown`, never zero. `closed` lists work closed as not done because its loop was archived or deleted (a task becomes skipped, a roadmap or queue item cancelled, a goal parked), each with the status it had; an archived loop's work is opened again when the loop is restored.
